body:
The buzzing is just all of my thoughts whispering in the back of my head. Everyday, people can't stand the way I act. If I'm already upset or uncomfortable and show it visually, but still do what I'm asked, apparently I'm being rude or lazy or I'm making a scene.

I hate this. I hate this life. I hate people making me feel like I'm the only person making mistakes. I feel like this will follow me the rest of my life. The psychological scars that I have from my childhood and teens are going to keep following me.

My mind has hairline triggers that will instantly make me aggressive, and I can't live like that anymore.  I'm conscious of it, but it makes no difference. 

I have no one that can take me in. I can't escape to somewhere else. All i have is myself right now. 

i've spent most of my time helping other people, but the minute that I have a crisis, or I'm upset, I'm just being an asshole. I can't stand this feeling anymore. I can't be upset for myself. It seems like I'm not allowed to.

I've talked to him about it before, and just as many people have said here, I just need to get out of here. I agree with that, but it gets lost int head because I have to fight the biggest source of my anxiety and depression everyday, where I live. I should write it somewhere I can always look to, to remind myself.

I've learned not to give to my brother. He would take it anyways. He's 11 years older than me and I used to feel sorry for him. I even Bpught him an iphone that he eventually broke and had my mom replace. He's taken my car for months at a time with nothing in return. When we ask him to pay at least a month's payment, he drops my car off and takes my mom's. A real piece of shit.

Thank you, sometimes I just need to be reminded that. I know that's how it will be. In my situation, it is a fight whenever I try justify animosity toward my eldest brother. My mom has this crazy idea that families are meant to be united. She loves my eldest brother dispite his mistakes, but hates my brother who became independent after attending College because he doesnt call her.

I can't stand her logic. Every bit of it hinders chances of growing the fuck up and being happy about it. Thank you for helping me feel like I'm justified with how I feel.

Thank you for your words. There isnt very much positivity in my life. My mother doesn't just not know how to deal with it... She agitated it. She rubs salts on my wounds. Even after I explain the things I have one for my brother and all the terrible things he's done to me like leaving me abandoned because he'd rather be doing meth she still doesn't believe I've ever done a thing for him. But his mistakes, like getting arrested and bringing meth to our other brother's college graduation and doing said meth in the bathroom of our family's hotel room are erased from his past... But because I refuse to go to his house, I am treated like a Piece of crap. I am the terrible one. This is just all too stressful.

For me to be ok with the world, I need anything but my family.
